## The **technology** and **innovation** to simplify a complex world

Our differentiated solutions solve challenges all over the globe.

[READ MORE][28]

## Reliable, resilient
## **power** management
## for **data centers**

Data centers power the digital services we rely on every day. Learn how AMETEK solutions address the
**complex energy management** challenges that data center operators face.

[READ MORE][29]

## The** career opportunities** to let bold talent flourish

Our inclusive culture empowers our employees to perform at their best.

[READ MORE][30]

## De-risking **data centers**

**Real-time simulation** is reshaping how data centers manage risk across their power systems. Learn
how AMETEK is helping **data centers de‑risk power systems** and accelerate deployment.

[READ MORE][31]

### Every day, our technology makes a** safer**,
### **sustainable **and more **productive ** world a reality.

**We do it by bringing together and investing in passionate, talented people.**

##### **As a leading global provider **of differentiated electronic instruments and
##### electromechanical devices, we are proud to solve some of the world’s most complex challenges.
##### Our strength comes from **four key areas**.

#### OUR NICHE MARKET FOCUS

### A combined vision for success

We target niche markets aligned with secular growth trends that provide multiple avenues of growth.

#### OUR GROWTH MODEL

### Designed to excel

The AMETEK Growth Model integrates Operational Excellence, New Product Development, Global and
Market Expansion, and Strategic Acquisitions with a focus on cash flow generation and disciplined
capital deployment.

#### OUR PEOPLE AND CULTURE

### United by bright prospects

We have a strong performance-driven and decentralized culture made of diverse high-performance teams
located across the globe that execute our strategy and embrace our values by doing the right thing
every day, in every interaction.

#### OUR PERFORMANCE

### Proud to be out in front

Our culture is to outperform. Over the past 15, 10, and 5-year periods we have substantially
outperformed the S&P 500 index and the S&P Industrials. We deliver double-digit earnings over the
business cycle.

### **Explore** our products

##### **Life is full of complex challenges****.** Each one inspires us to do what we love. To make
##### the world a better place. Not just with our differentiated technologies that improve countless
##### lives, but by **empowering our people to inspire others** across the globe.

AMETEK CONSISTS OF TWO DIFFERENTIATED OPERATING GROUPS

## Our electronic instruments

AMETEK is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacturing of advanced analytical, test and
measurement instrumentation for the energy, aerospace, power, research, medical and industrial
markets.
BOTH OPERATING GROUPS OCCUPY LEADING POSITIONS IN NICHE MARKETS

## Our electromechanical devices

We are world-renowned as a differentiated supplier of automation and precision motion control
solutions, and highly engineered electrical interconnects, specialty metals and thermal management
systems.

### Learn more about **AMETEK**

# Introducing Measurlink 11

MeasurLink® 11 delivers the most significant usability and workflow improvements to the platform in
years. Designed to simplify implementation, reduce training requirements, and improve user
experience, Version 11 helps manufacturers spend less time managing software and more time improving
quality.

[Learn More][240]
Florida, Precision Has a New Home

Mitutoyo America's new 11,200-square-foot Lakeland Metrology Service Center brings our full range of
services to the Southeast, supporting the region’s manufacturers and industrial growth.

[Learn More][241]
Experience The New CRYSTA-Apex V PLUS

High-speed CNC measurement that leaves the lab and enters the shop floor. Now with expanded
temperature tolerance and eco-friendly efficiency.

[Learn More][242]
Measure in Seconds, Not Minutes.

The New Mitutoyo QM-Fit is a compact, fully automated smart vision system designed to deliver fast,
accurate results without the need for setup.

[Learn More][243]
MEET THE NEW QUICK IMAGE WITH M3

Experience the new, more powerful Mitutoyo Quick Image vision system now integrated with Metlogix M3
software that delivers faster results and greater versatility. Featuring a more user-friendly,
intuitive interface, the QI with M3 streamlines non-contact measurements with excellent accuracy.

[Learn More][244]
THE ULTIMATE SHOP-FLOOR CMM

MiSTAR is built for where precision matters most. It offers two compact CNC CMMs engineered for
tough shop-floor environments, delivering fast, reliable, high-accuracy inspections at the point of
production to help you maintain quality without slowing down your workflow.

[Learn More][245]
[lab]

## Create a Custom Precision Measurement Lab for Your Business

[Learn More][246]

Get enterprise-level quality control capabilities at an accessible price point - perfect for
boosting accuracy and productivity on your shop floor or quality lab.

## Precision Metrology for Your Industry

Mitutoyo works with companies in numerous industries to provide the advanced precision measurement
solutions they need for accurate, efficient production. See what our solutions can do for your
specific applications.

[View All Industries][247]

## Aerospace Solutions

Enhance aerospace system safety, performance and traceability with advanced metrology solutions that
allow you to model, simulate and validate designs ahead of production and assembly.

[View Solutions][248]

## Automotive Solutions

Improve overall vehicle safety and performance, shrink design-to-production times and increase
accuracy across the vehicle supply chain with our best-in-class precision metrology solutions.

[View Solutions][249]

## Medical Solutions

Bring unmatched accuracy and reliability to diagnostic and therapeutic devices, pharmaceutical goods
and countless other highly sensitive medical engineering applications with leading precision
metrology solutions.

[View Solutions][250]

## Energy Solutions

Make critical equipment components for oil and gas, solar, wind or nuclear as precise as possible
with advanced metrology solutions from Mitutoyo.

[View Solutions][251]
[[Mitutoyo Metrology Calibration Lab]][252]

## High Precision Calibration Lab

Our ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory delivers the precision calibration services you can trust to
maintain accuracy on all Mitutoyo tools and instruments as well as other brands.

[Learn More][253]
[[precision measurement services]][254]

## Unequalled Support and Partnership

Learn more about the range of support services Mitutoyo offers, from installation and repair to
ongoing training and education from our leading metrology experts.

[Learn More][255]

## Complete Resource Library

We are your one-stop shop for metrology, measurement and quality assurance information. Find
everything you need to make more informed decisions and advance your business.

[Learn More][256]

# Introducing Measurlink 11

MeasurLink® 11 delivers the most significant usability and workflow improvements to the platform in
years. Designed to simplify implementation, reduce training requirements, and improve user
experience, Version 11 helps manufacturers spend less time managing software and more time improving
quality.

[Learn More][240]
Florida, Precision Has a New Home

Mitutoyo America's new 11,200-square-foot Lakeland Metrology Service Center brings our full range of
services to the Southeast, supporting the region’s manufacturers and industrial growth.

[Learn More][241]
Experience The New CRYSTA-Apex V PLUS

High-speed CNC measurement that leaves the lab and enters the shop floor. Now with expanded
temperature tolerance and eco-friendly efficiency.

[Learn More][242]
Measure in Seconds, Not Minutes.

The New Mitutoyo QM-Fit is a compact, fully automated smart vision system designed to deliver fast,
accurate results without the need for setup.

[Learn More][243]
MEET THE NEW QUICK IMAGE WITH M3

Experience the new, more powerful Mitutoyo Quick Image vision system now integrated with Metlogix M3
software that delivers faster results and greater versatility. Featuring a more user-friendly,
intuitive interface, the QI with M3 streamlines non-contact measurements with excellent accuracy.

[Learn More][244]
THE ULTIMATE SHOP-FLOOR CMM

MiSTAR is built for where precision matters most. It offers two compact CNC CMMs engineered for
tough shop-floor environments, delivering fast, reliable, high-accuracy inspections at the point of
production to help you maintain quality without slowing down your workflow.

[Learn More][245]
[lab]

## Create a Custom Precision Measurement Lab for Your Business

[Learn More][246]

Get enterprise-level quality control capabilities at an accessible price point - perfect for
boosting accuracy and productivity on your shop floor or quality lab.

## Precision Metrology for Your Industry

Mitutoyo works with companies in numerous industries to provide the advanced precision measurement
solutions they need for accurate, efficient production. See what our solutions can do for your
specific applications.

[View All Industries][247]

## Aerospace Solutions

Enhance aerospace system safety, performance and traceability with advanced metrology solutions that
allow you to model, simulate and validate designs ahead of production and assembly.

[View Solutions][248]

## Automotive Solutions

Improve overall vehicle safety and performance, shrink design-to-production times and increase
accuracy across the vehicle supply chain with our best-in-class precision metrology solutions.

[View Solutions][249]

## Medical Solutions

Bring unmatched accuracy and reliability to diagnostic and therapeutic devices, pharmaceutical goods
and countless other highly sensitive medical engineering applications with leading precision
metrology solutions.

[View Solutions][250]

## Energy Solutions

Make critical equipment components for oil and gas, solar, wind or nuclear as precise as possible
with advanced metrology solutions from Mitutoyo.

[View Solutions][251]
[[Mitutoyo Metrology Calibration Lab]][252]

## High Precision Calibration Lab

Our ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory delivers the precision calibration services you can trust to
maintain accuracy on all Mitutoyo tools and instruments as well as other brands.

[Learn More][253]
[[precision measurement services]][254]

## Unequalled Support and Partnership

Learn more about the range of support services Mitutoyo offers, from installation and repair to
ongoing training and education from our leading metrology experts.

[Learn More][255]

## Complete Resource Library

We are your one-stop shop for metrology, measurement and quality assurance information. Find
everything you need to make more informed decisions and advance your business.

# What if AI could do an engineer’s most tedious work?

We’ve launched the Eigen Engineering Agent, purpose-built AI for industrial automation engineering.
It moves AI beyond generating suggestions to executing engineering tasks end-to-end. Now available
for more than 600,000 TIA Portal users.

[Start free trial][3][How AI transforms Engineering][4]
[CES 2026: Roland Busch & Jensen Huang, Siemens & NVIDIA]

## Building the operating system for Industrial AI

Together with NVIDIA, we are building the Industrial AI operating system for the physical world.
Read the latest news from our ever-expanding partnership here.

[Learn more][5]

The next generation of locomotives for freight and passenger transport combines the proven platform
technology with app-based functionalities, open interfaces for third-party providers, in an open
ecosystem – connecting people, places and portfolios more closely than ever before.

[Read more][6]

points, energy meters and documents, to create a single source of truth and enable efficient,
data-driven operations acrossthe campus.

boosting income for the local community by 60%.

# **CALIBRATION LABORATORY SERVICES**

“Accurate Calibration & Testing Center LLP, Pune” is the trusted name in Mechanical Calibrations. We
are one of the leading calibration service providers, having more than 1000 clients throughout
Maharashtra & other States of India. We are providing impressive range of calibration services in
our permanent laboratory together with calibration at customer sites (where required).

We are NABL (National Accreditation Board for Testing & Calibration Laboratory, Dept. of Science &
Technology, New Delhi) accredited laboratory, vide Certificate No. CC-2188. We provide high-quality,
state-of-the-art calibrations with documentation that satisfies industry and regulatory or audit
requirements.

We're constantly updating and expanding our calibration capabilities by listening to your business
requirements, committing financial resources to new instruments and dedicating many hours to
extensive employee certification and training. Remaining up-to-date with instrumentation and
techniques is crucial to your success and ours.

## RELENTLESS FOCUS ON QUALITY, AFFORDABILITY,
## AND FLAWLESS EXECUTION

To unlock and sustain productivity levels, you need to move fast with extreme accuracy.

ATT Metrology Solutions brings specialist knowledge and expertise to provide full metrology
solutions in the form of onsite services and integrated systems for your unique calibration,
measurement and inspection needs.

We are one of the few metrology companies in the world certified by Boeing to perform metrology
services. In addition, ATT is the only U.S. metrology company approved and certified by Airbus to
perform inspections on both tooling and production parts.

Count on ATT to be your [metrology][35] integration solutions partner for your next project. We
measure success by the effectiveness of your results.

## Operational Metrology Support

ATT deploys experienced metrology professionals into complex manufacturing environments to support
portable metrology, CMM programming, alignment, reverse engineering, and onsite inspection across
customer-native software and hardware systems.

## ATT METROLOGY SOLUTIONS

Driving Innovation and Efficiency in Every Phase

[Integrated Systems][Integrated Systems]

### Integrated Systems

ATT is the premier metrology company offering fully integrated metrology solutions that automate
inspection processes and reduce the skillset required to operate a production system. Whether you
require precision or accuracy, we serve as a catalyst for change, shaping metrology solutions with a
deep understanding, knowledge and technical capability to deliver multi-component metrology systems.

[Learn More][38]

[Skilled Labor Services][Skilled Labor Services]

### Skilled Labor Services

Our metrology company offers engineering, measurement and consulting services, as well as
fabrication and assembly capability.  We have a deep understanding of the latest metrology
technologies and methods that allows us to provide better measurement and inspection services,
helping our clients improve quality, reduce waste, and optimize their manufacturing processes.

[Learn More][39]

[Equipment Rentals][Equipment Rentals]

### Equipment Rentals

ATT offers a huge breadth of pre-calibrated, ready-to-use equipment, including laser trackers,
photogrammetry and laser scanners, for virtually any application. Our metrology company’s rentals
service is a fast and cost-effective way to get the equipment you need. You only pay for it when you
need it. Our experience serving specific industries, such as aerospace, shipbuilding, satellite,
energy and civil is a key advantage in understanding the unique challenges and requirements of these
industries and providing tailored solutions.

[Learn More][40]

[Products][Products]

### Products

We provide a broad portfolio of metrology targets and target adapters, including scale bars. From
drift nests and extension bar assemblies to tooling monuments, we have the inspection parts you
need. This allows us to offer a more comprehensive solution to our clients and help them address a
wider range of needs.

"All of us at MAGLEV, Inc. would like to thank ATT Metrology for the help you gave our T-Rex

piece of paper)."

MAGLEV, Inc.

"The University of Washington Capstone Aircraft Design Class would like to thank you for your

## RELENTLESS FOCUS ON QUALITY, AFFORDABILITY,
## AND FLAWLESS EXECUTION

To unlock and sustain productivity levels, you need to move fast with extreme accuracy.

ATT Metrology Solutions brings specialist knowledge and expertise to provide full metrology
solutions in the form of onsite services and integrated systems for your unique calibration,
measurement and inspection needs.

We are one of the few metrology companies in the world certified by Boeing to perform metrology
services. In addition, ATT is the only U.S. metrology company approved and certified by Airbus to
perform inspections on both tooling and production parts.

Count on ATT to be your [metrology][35] integration solutions partner for your next project. We
measure success by the effectiveness of your results.

ATT deploys experienced metrology professionals into complex manufacturing environments to support
portable metrology, CMM programming, alignment, reverse engineering, and onsite inspection across
customer-native software and hardware systems.

## ATT METROLOGY SOLUTIONS

Driving Innovation and Efficiency in Every Phase

[Integrated Systems][Integrated Systems]

### Integrated Systems

ATT is the premier metrology company offering fully integrated metrology solutions that automate
inspection processes and reduce the skillset required to operate a production system. Whether you
require precision or accuracy, we serve as a catalyst for change, shaping metrology solutions with a
deep understanding, knowledge and technical capability to deliver multi-component metrology systems.

[Learn More][38]

[Skilled Labor Services][Skilled Labor Services]

### Skilled Labor Services

Our metrology company offers engineering, measurement and consulting services, as well as
fabrication and assembly capability.  We have a deep understanding of the latest metrology
technologies and methods that allows us to provide better measurement and inspection services,
helping our clients improve quality, reduce waste, and optimize their manufacturing processes.

[Learn More][39]

[Equipment Rentals][Equipment Rentals]

### Equipment Rentals

ATT offers a huge breadth of pre-calibrated, ready-to-use equipment, including laser trackers,
photogrammetry and laser scanners, for virtually any application. Our metrology company’s rentals
service is a fast and cost-effective way to get the equipment you need. You only pay for it when you
need it. Our experience serving specific industries, such as aerospace, shipbuilding, satellite,
energy and civil is a key advantage in understanding the unique challenges and requirements of these
industries and providing tailored solutions.

[Learn More][40]

[Products][Products]

### Products

We provide a broad portfolio of metrology targets and target adapters, including scale bars. From
drift nests and extension bar assemblies to tooling monuments, we have the inspection parts you
need. This allows us to offer a more comprehensive solution to our clients and help them address a
wider range of needs.

[Life Science Hubs on US Map]

## Keep Your Lab Audit-Ready and Operating at Maximum Uptime

Keep your critical lab equipment running with accredited calibration, preventive maintenance,
validation, and repair services delivered by our fleet of mobile technicians in **Boston**, **San
Francisco**, **San Jose**, **Los Angeles**, and **San Diego**. We respond to every equipment repair
request within 24 hours or less.

[Request Service ][57]
 
[Mobile Lab Service Techs]

## Fast, Local, and Fully Equipped

### Mobile techs deliver accredited lab services in leading Life Sciences hubs

Flagship Lab Services’ mobile technicians bring the full range of our lab equipment services to your
facility. Performing [calibrations][58], [validations][59], and [preventive maintenance][60] or
triaging a needed [repair][61], our ability to work on-site reduces your downtime while keeping your
lab equipment fully compliant and operating at peak efficiency. Our team at the depot stands ready
to receive more complex repair work for more complex repairs.

Serving Life Sciences leaders in San Francisco, San Diego, Los Angeles, and Boston, our mobile
technicians are the front line of Flagship lab support services.

## Quality You Can Trust

Every service we perform is backed by rigorous quality systems and highly trained technicians,
ensuring consistent, audit-ready service across your lab operations.

**Organizational Accreditations**
* [ISO/IEC 17025:2017][62] (A2LA Accredited) for calibration services
* [ISO 9001:2015][63] Certified quality management system covering sales, field service, depot
  repairs, equipment validation, and related operations

**Life Science Technician™ (LST™) Program**

Our proprietary [Life Science Technician™ (LST) certification program][64] prepares technicians to
work safely and effectively in regulated laboratory environments. As part of the program,
technicians also earn certifications in:
* DOT (Hazardous Materials Handling & Transportation)

### Calibration Services Supplier Directory Overview

Find and compare calibration services from suppliers specializing in laboratory instruments, gauges,
test equipment, production systems, and other precision devices used across manufacturing,
healthcare, pharmaceutical processing, aerospace, energy, and research environments. This directory
helps buyers browse calibration companies by service scope, application, accreditation, and industry
fit so they can source providers that support traceability, compliance, and dependable measurement
performance. Whether you need industrial calibration services, instrumentation calibration services,
or laboratory calibration services, this page is built to connect purchasing teams, engineers, lab
managers, and quality personnel with suppliers equipped to handle a wide range of calibration
requirements.

### Test Equipment Calibration Services

Test equipment calibration services help verify and adjust instruments used to measure voltage,
current, frequency, pressure, force, and other critical variables. These services support
manufacturers, research labs, utilities, and technical service organizations that depend on
dependable readings for inspection, troubleshooting, validation, and process control.

### Laboratory Calibration Services

Laboratory calibration services focus on balances, pipettes, temperature devices, measuring
instruments, and other lab assets that must perform within defined tolerances. These services are
used in healthcare, pharmaceutical production, biotechnology, materials testing, and scientific
research environments where repeatability, documentation, and traceable results matter.

### Instrumentation Calibration Services

Instrumentation calibration services address sensors, transmitters, recorders, and process
instruments that keep operations stable and measurable. Process industries, automation-driven
plants, food production facilities, water treatment operations, and energy sites rely on these
services to maintain control accuracy and reduce the risk of drift-related errors.

### Equipment Calibration Services Across Production Systems

Equipment calibration services cover broader production and facility assets, including gauges,
meters, controllers, and integrated systems used on plant floors and in technical workspaces. Buyers
in heavy manufacturing, electronics assembly, regulated processing, and field service operations
often need suppliers that can support both bench instruments and installed equipment. Some projects
may also require specialized capabilities such as EMC calibration for devices operating in sensitive
electrical environments.

### Industries That Rely on Calibration Services

Manufacturing operations rely on calibration services for gauges, sensors, and test equipment that
support throughput, dimensional control, and repeatable production. Pharmaceutical and laboratory
environments require lab instrument calibration services for balances, temperature devices, and
measurement tools tied to documentation and compliance. Healthcare settings depend on reliable
instrument performance to support diagnostic and clinical processes. Aerospace and defense
applications need tightly controlled calibration for high-precision instruments and inspection
systems. Energy, utilities, and process industries use instrumentation calibration services to
maintain stable readings across pressure, flow, electrical, and environmental monitoring points.

### Selecting the Right Calibration Scope

Buyers should start by matching calibration scope to production volume, equipment count, and
required turnaround time. A facility with large instrument inventories or frequent verification
cycles may need a supplier that can support scheduled service, higher throughput, and flexible
reporting across multiple asset types.

### Process Type and Service Requirements

Process type also matters. Laboratory work, plant-floor instrumentation, field devices, and
regulated quality systems often require different procedures, environmental controls, and
documentation depth. Equipment calibration services should align with how the instrument is actually
used, not just what it is called on an asset list.

### On-Site vs Laboratory Calibration

Integration is another major consideration. Some buyers need on-site service to reduce downtime,
while others need controlled lab conditions for sensitive devices. When comparing calibration
companies, ask how they manage pickup, scheduling, asset tracking, certificates, and recalibration
intervals.

Laboratory calibration services focus on balances, pipettes, temperature devices, measuring
instruments, and other lab assets that must perform within defined tolerances. These services are
used in healthcare, pharmaceutical production, biotechnology, materials testing, and scientific
research environments where repeatability, documentation, and traceable results matter.

### Instrumentation Calibration Services

Instrumentation calibration services address sensors, transmitters, recorders, and process
instruments that keep operations stable and measurable. Process industries, automation-driven
plants, food production facilities, water treatment operations, and energy sites rely on these
services to maintain control accuracy and reduce the risk of drift-related errors.

### Equipment Calibration Services Across Production Systems

Equipment calibration services cover broader production and facility assets, including gauges,
meters, controllers, and integrated systems used on plant floors and in technical workspaces. Buyers
in heavy manufacturing, electronics assembly, regulated processing, and field service operations
often need suppliers that can support both bench instruments and installed equipment. Some projects
may also require specialized capabilities such as EMC calibration for devices operating in sensitive
electrical environments.

### Industries That Rely on Calibration Services

Manufacturing operations rely on calibration services for gauges, sensors, and test equipment that
support throughput, dimensional control, and repeatable production. Pharmaceutical and laboratory
environments require lab instrument calibration services for balances, temperature devices, and
measurement tools tied to documentation and compliance. Healthcare settings depend on reliable
instrument performance to support diagnostic and clinical processes. Aerospace and defense
applications need tightly controlled calibration for high-precision instruments and inspection
systems. Energy, utilities, and process industries use instrumentation calibration services to
maintain stable readings across pressure, flow, electrical, and environmental monitoring points.

### Selecting the Right Calibration Scope

Buyers should start by matching calibration scope to production volume, equipment count, and
required turnaround time. A facility with large instrument inventories or frequent verification
cycles may need a supplier that can support scheduled service, higher throughput, and flexible
reporting across multiple asset types.

### Process Type and Service Requirements

Process type also matters. Laboratory work, plant-floor instrumentation, field devices, and
regulated quality systems often require different procedures, environmental controls, and
documentation depth. Equipment calibration services should align with how the instrument is actually
used, not just what it is called on an asset list.

### On-Site vs Laboratory Calibration

Integration is another major consideration. Some buyers need on-site service to reduce downtime,
while others need controlled lab conditions for sensitive devices. When comparing calibration
companies, ask how they manage pickup, scheduling, asset tracking, certificates, and recalibration
intervals.

### Inspection, Certification, and Traceability

standards, documented uncertainty, calibration records, and support for internal audits or customer

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

## Creaform Metrology Suite^{TM}

Proven, reliable 3D metrology software for real-world challenges
The Creaform Metrology Suite offers a comprehensive portfolio of application software modules
tailored for metrology applications, including product development, reverse engineering, inspection,
dynamic tracking, and digital twin generation.
[Metrology Software][108]

## FARO 3D Metrology Offering

FARO Technologies, Strengthening Leadership in 3D Metrology and Laser Projection Solutions
[Learn more about FARO Solutions][109]

## Experience the performance of portable 3D scanners

Whether you are in the lab, on the shop floor, or out in the field, you need to rely on portable,
metrology-grade 3D scanners that pack a true punch in terms of ease of use, accuracy, resolution,
reliability and fast data acquisition.
[Ask for a live demo][110]

## 3D Measurement Solutions
* Product Development and Design
  
  Product development refers to all of the stages involved in bringing a product to market—from
  inception through conception and engineering design to product development. 
* Quality control and Quality assurance
  
  3D scanning and probing technologies —handheld or automated—enable QC and QA engineers and
  managers to measure the dimensions and validate the quality of manufactured parts as well as find
  the root cause of issues detected during inspections.
* Reverse Engineering
  
  Creaform’s handheld 3D scanners enable CAD engineers and industrial designers to create 3D models
  from existing physical objects.
* Science and Education
  
  An educational solution for forward-thinking teachers and researchers looking to inspire,
  collaborate, and push the innovation envelope forward by using the latest advancements in 3D
  measurement technologies.

[3D Measurement Solutions][111]

### What is the frequency and duration of your classes?

Typically, the number of classes is two per week for grades K to 8, and three per week for high
school. But the schedule is flexible, according to your child's requirements and availability. Also,
each class runs for 55 minutes, extendable to an hour.

### What devices do I need for attending your classes?

A desktop or laptop computer that supports video calling is necessary for attending our classes. We
also highly recommend a writing tablet for the best learning experience.

### My child has specific learning requirements. Is your program flexible enough?

Absolutely. Our tutors will always customize the classes according to what your child needs - be it
homework help, exam or test prep, remedial support for past gaps, or advanced learning.

### Can your tutors teach the topics covered in my child’s school or curriculum?

### What is the frequency and duration of your classes?

Typically, the number of classes is two per week for grades K to 8, and three per week for high
school. But the schedule is flexible, according to your child's requirements and availability. Also,
each class runs for 55 minutes, extendable to an hour.

### What devices do I need for attending your classes?

A desktop or laptop computer that supports video calling is necessary for attending our classes. We
also highly recommend a writing tablet for the best learning experience.

### My child has specific learning requirements. Is your program flexible enough?

Absolutely. Our tutors will always customize the classes according to what your child needs - be it
homework help, exam or test prep, remedial support for past gaps, or advanced learning.

### Can your tutors teach the topics covered in my child’s school or curriculum?

Our tutors are trained to teach according to various curricula across countries. Furthe

## Home

Dimensional Measurement, Inc. (DMI) is a contract dimensional inspection services company accredited
to ISO/IEC 17025:2005.  DMI offers dimensional inspection, fixed and portable CMM inspection, video
inspection, laser scanning, reverse engineering and on-site contract measurement support.

DMI is North America's foremost CMM inspection facility

In today’s fast-paced manufacturing economy, customer demands and compressed time schedules must be
honored.  On-time delivery with Total Quality is the new standard and not just the goal.  Inspection
is typically the final operation in the manufacturing process, and one with which delays can and
frequently do occur.

Enter DMI, your metrology outsourcing inspection partner.  Dimensional Measurement, Inc. is a full
service contract inspection house with the equipment, manpower and experience to take your
inspection challenges in our stride and provide you and your customers with the information needed
in a timely manner.  Some of our capabilities are:
* Dimensional inspection with full capability of utilizing CAD data
* CMM inspection including full Pictorial Reporting
* First Article Inspection
* Impartial Evaluation
* Process Capability Studies
* Video and Optical inspection
* Reverse Engineering
* Digitizing
* Checking Fixtures
* Portable inspection at your site
* Contract 3D Laser Scanning

*We are committed to providing our Customers with the BEST service available; **we have built our
company on a foundation of repeat customers.*

Follow Me[[RSS Feed]][11]
Dimensional Measurement, Inc is a Premier Accredited Contract Inspection Services Company

## Home

Dimensional Measurement, Inc. (DMI) is a contract dimensional inspection services company accredited
to ISO/IEC 17025:2005.  DMI offers dimensional inspection, fixed and portable CMM inspection, video
inspection, laser scanning, reverse engineering and on-site contract measurement support.

DMI is North America's foremost CMM inspection facility

In today’s fast-paced manufacturing economy, customer demands and compressed time schedules must be
honored.  On-time delivery with Total Quality is the new standard and not just the goal.  Inspection
is typically the final operation in the manufacturing process, and one with which delays can and
frequently do occur.

Enter DMI, your metrology outsourcing inspection partner.  Dimensional Measurement, Inc. is a full
service contract inspection house with the equipment, manpower and experience to take your
inspection challenges in our stride and provide you and your customers with the information needed
in a timely manner.  Some of our capabilities are:
* Dimensional inspection with full capability of utilizing CAD data
* CMM inspection including full Pictorial Reporting
* First Article Inspection
* Impartial Evaluation
* Process Capability Studies
* Video and Optical inspection
* Reverse Engineering
* Digitizing
* Checking Fixtures
* Portable inspection at your site
* Contract 3D Laser Scanning

*We are committed to providing our Customers with the BEST service available; **we have built our
company on a foundation of repeat customers.*

# PRECISION MEASUREMENT SOLUTIONS

# ELEVATING INDUSTRY STANDARDS

Our highly-trained and certified metrology team consistently delivers quality service solutions that
are innovative and industry proven

[LEARN MORE][35] [CONTACT US][36]

## Unlocking Precision Excellence: Explore Our Services

Welcome to ECM Global Measurement Solutions, where precision meets expertise. With a legacy dating
back to 2001, we have established ourselves as industry leaders in measurement and alignment
services. Our laser tracker services deploy field engineers for short and long-term projects,
delivering unparalleled expertise directly to your doorstep. Meanwhile, our onsite precision for
industrial applications specializes in large-scale projects, ranging from aircraft and power plants
to yachts and bridges. Our seasoned metrologists bring precision to every corner, equipped with the
perfect tools for capturing onsite data, ensuring seamless post-processing, and delivering
comprehensive reports. Trust ECM for precision that goes beyond boundaries.

### Precision Measurement & Alignment

In virtually every industrial application, the benefits of highly precise measurement solutions are
paramount. In situations where even a deviation of a thousandth of an inch could have adverse
effects on quality, ECM is equipped with specialized tools and expertise to deliver prompt,
accurate, and consistent metrology solutions.

[Learn More][37]

### Accredited Instrument Calibrations

Calibrated metrology instruments are crucial in situations where even the slightest deviation from
technical specifications can result in catastrophic outcomes such as equipment failure, accidents,
or significant financial loss. An ISO/IEC 17025 accredited instrument calibration guarantees the
consistent delivery of accurate results and minimizes errors during critical applications. By
adhering to a predefined calibration schedule, you mitigate the risk of inaccurate measurements and
enhance the longevity of your measuring system.

[Learn More][38]

### Training & Certification

Our training programs are designed to equip you with the knowledge and expertise required for
assembly, manufacturing, and quality assurance roles. You’ll also gain insights into the intricacies
of typical inspection tasks, ensuring you’re well-prepared for real-world challenges. Join us and
elevate your proficiency in ECM with our dynamic and application-focused curriculum.

[Learn More][39]

### LiDar Scanning for AEC Industry

ECM brings a new standard of quality to dimensional measurement through a combination of
best-in-class 3D technologies, proven metrology processes, application specific expertise and the
right balance of after service support. Whether servicing small manufacturers or leading companies
across a diverse range of industries, we take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive
solutions to meet clients’ architectural, engineering, and construction support needs.

[Learn More][40]

### Industry Applications

Drawing on vast expertise across aerospace, automotive, marine, medical, power generation,
manufacturing, and diverse industries, ECM partners with businesses of all sizes, from local
enterprises to Fortune 500 giants. From micro-components to massive structures, our extensive suite
of measuring tools ensures we meet each customer’s distinct needs. Our pledge is to deliver precise
measurements customized to your specifications, regardless of your business’s scale or sector. At
ECM, we prioritize your quality requirements above all else.

# PRECISION MEASUREMENT SOLUTIONS

# ELEVATING INDUSTRY STANDARDS

Our highly-trained and certified metrology team consistently delivers quality service solutions that
are innovative and industry proven

[LEARN MORE][35] [CONTACT US][36]

## Unlocking Precision Excellence: Explore Our Services

Welcome to ECM Global Measurement Solutions, where precision meets expertise. With a legacy dating
back to 2001, we have established ourselves as industry leaders in measurement and alignment
services. Our laser tracker services deploy field engineers for short and long-term projects,
delivering unparalleled expertise directly to your doorstep. Meanwhile, our onsite precision for
industrial applications specializes in large-scale projects, ranging from aircraft and power plants
to yachts and bridges. Our seasoned metrologists bring precision to every corner, equipped with the
perfect tools for capturing onsite data, ensuring seamless post-processing, and delivering
comprehensive reports. Trust ECM for precision that goes beyond boundaries.

### Precision Measurement & Alignment

In virtually every industrial application, the benefits of highly precise measurement solutions are
paramount. In situations where even a deviation of a thousandth of an inch could have adverse
effects on quality, ECM is equipped with specialized tools and expertise to deliver prompt,
accurate, and consistent metrology solutions.

[Learn More][37]

### Accredited Instrument Calibrations

Calibrated metrology instruments are crucial in situations where even the slightest deviation from
technical specifications can result in catastrophic outcomes such as equipment failure, accidents,
or significant financial loss. An ISO/IEC 17025 accredited instrument calibration guarantees the
consistent delivery of accurate results and minimizes errors during critical applications. By
adhering to a predefined calibration schedule, you mitigate the risk of inaccurate measurements and
enhance the longevity of your measuring system.

[Learn More][38]

### Training & Certification

Our training programs are designed to equip you with the knowledge and expertise required for
assembly, manufacturing, and quality assurance roles. You’ll also gain insights into the intricacies
of typical inspection tasks, ensuring you’re well-prepared for real-world challenges. Join us and
elevate your proficiency in ECM with our dynamic and application-focused curriculum.

[Learn More][39]

### LiDar Scanning for AEC Industry

ECM brings a new standard of quality to dimensional measurement through a combination of
best-in-class 3D technologies, proven metrology processes, application specific expertise and the
right balance of after service support. Whether servicing small manufacturers or leading companies
across a diverse range of industries, we take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive
solutions to meet clients’ architectural, engineering, and construction support needs.

[Learn More][40]

### Industry Applications

Drawing on vast expertise across aerospace, automotive, marine, medical, power generation,
manufacturing, and diverse industries, ECM partners with businesses of all sizes, from local
enterprises to Fortune 500 giants. From micro-components to massive structures, our extensive suite
of measuring tools ensures we meet each customer’s distinct needs. Our pledge is to deliver precise
measurements customized to your specifications, regardless of your business’s scale or sector. At
ECM, we prioritize your quality requirements above all else.

Cheers to 28 years! Here’s to many more years of building confidence with our customers, associates,

trust and confidence.” Scott Barlow, CEO

### We provide NIST traceable calibration services for electronic, physical and dimensional test and
### measuring equipment.

EML Calibration Services is a Nashville based Calibration company that’s ISO/IEC 17025:2017
accredited by the **Perry Johnson Laboratory Accreditation**. Before, after and/or uncertainties are
available per request.

EML’s online asset management platform will give you peace of mind knowing you will stay compliant
and ensure better controls within your quality program. The system will store your assets, their
calibration date and expiration dates, and notify you of any upcoming calibration requirements.

We specialize in:
* Electronic Calibration
* Mechanical Calibration
* On-Site Calibration
* Torque Calibration

retrofit, plus a redesign of the machine to enhance its capabilities and improve its productivity.

to ISO/IEC 17025:2005. Offering dimesional inspection, fixed and portable CMM inspection, video
inspection, laser scanning, reverse engineering and onsite manpower contracting we offer the best
service available.

DMI are North America's Foremost CMM Inspection Facility

is typically the final operation in the manufacturing process and one with which delays can and
frequently do occur.

Enter DMI, your metrology outsourcing inspection partner. DMI is a full service contract inspection
house with the equipment, manpower and experience to take your inspection difficulties in our stride
and provide you and your customers with the information needed in a timely manner.
* Dimensional Inspection with full capability of utilizing CAD data.

* First Article Inspection

* Video and Optical Inspection
* Reverse Engineering
* Digitizing
* Checking Fixtures

*World-leading inspection and remediation partners.*

We are a leading measurement, inspection and remediation company with over 20 years' experience
developing innovative solutions for the energy sector. OMS crawlers, tools and services deploy on
major global energy projects, to support and deliver critical requirements.

### Pipe-end Measurement

### Weld Inspection

### Remediation

Services
* ## Mechanically-lined pipe inspection
  
  Assess the internal dimensions of pipe that has been mechanically lined.
  
  [ More info ][26]
* ## Weld overlay inspection
  
  Identify and solve any defects in weld overlays that could affect asset integrity.
  
  [ More info ][27]
* ## Third-party inspection and verification
  
  Third-party inspection and verification services in pipes and pipe welds.
  
  [ More info ][28]
* ## Coatability inspection
  
  Ensure welds are ready for coating with our coatability inspection service.
  
  [ More info ][29]
* ## Bend tests
  
  Assessing pipe shape during reeling trials.
  
  [ More info ][30]
* ## Corrosion inspection and identification
  
  Our corrosion inspection and identification service helps clients in the energy industry detect
  and identify corrosion problems within pipes.
  
  [ More info ][31]
* ## Spool and pipe-lay ovality checker
  
  Verify pipe ovality during the reeling process to ensure pipeline integrity and prolong asset
  lifetime.
  
  [ More info ][32]
* ## J-tube inspection and remediation
  
  OMS weld inspection and remediation technology identifies and resolves weld defects within J-tubes
  for offshore wind installations.
  
  [ More info ][33]
* ## HiLo measurement
  
  Measuring HiLo just before welding confirms the best fit-up selections for critical
  fatigue-sensitive pipes and reduces the chance of expensive weld-related cut outs.
  
  [ More info ][34]
* ## Automatic grinding - SmartGrind
  
  OMS SmartGrind solves weld defects at an early stage, ensuring potential problems are identified
  and remediated rapidly.
  
  [ More info ][35]
* ## Bevel inspection
  
  The Bevel360 provides comprehensive information on pipe bevel geometry, helping welding proceed
  efficiently.
  
  [ More info ][36]
* ## SmartFit
  
  SmartFit™ helps clients achieve the best possible fit-up, even in complex critical pipeline
  sections such as spool pieces, risers and stalk tie-ins.
  
  [ More info ][37]
* ## Pipe-end measurement
  
  OMS has been providing ground-breaking laser end measurement and fit-up services to the energy
  industry for more than 20 years.
  
  [ More info ][38]
* ## Weld inspection
  
  Specialist award-winning camera and laser inspection services for hard-to-reach areas within
  energy production.
  
  [ More info ][39]

  Every stage in energy production depends on good quality welds. Each weld is a critical link on
  which the integrity of an entire system rests. Weld inspection plays a vital role in ensuring
  pipelines are strong, safe and long-lasting.
  
  [Read Guide][44]

  ## Guide to pipe measurement
  
  Pipeline integrity is an aspect that underpins every pipeline in existence and is a critical
  consideration for all operators regardless of the company size, location or length of the
  pipelines they control.
  
  [Read Guide][45]
* [Guide to robotics in oil and gas]
  
  ## Guide to robotics in oil and gas
  
  Robots have been in use in oil and gas production since the 1950s and are now deployed across
  every area of the industry. Increased numbers of robots has enhanced operations, reduced costs,
  improved safety and increased asset performance.
  
  [Read Guide][46]
* [Independent verification]
  
  ## Independent verification

> rates for CRA pipelines. Tremendous teamwork and performance under challenging pandemic
> circumstances, looking forward to a successful offshore campaign later this year!”

— Mathieu Lancien, Principal Materials Engineer
Projects
[
][48]
[ OMS completes measurement project in Qatar ][49]

OMS recently completed a project to measure a quantity of 8” pre-qualified pipe at our client’s
coating yard in Qatar.

[
][50]
[ Successful bending trial in Indonesia ][51]

OMS recently carried out laser mapping and visual inspection of mechanically lined 261mm pipes
before and after a full-scale reeling simulation.

[
][52]
[ OMS robotic weld remediation service helps Dynex achieve stringent project specifications ][53]

OMS completes successful project to remediate welds, achieving stringent project specifications of
<1.5mm throughout many kilometres of newly fabricated pipeline.

[
][54]
[ Measurement and fit-up at Zuluf ][55]

OMS has successfully completed pipe-end measurement and fit-up work at the Zuluf Field Expansion
project, owned and operated by [Saudi Aramco][56].

[
][57]
[ Project wins in 2025 ][58]

OMS has recently won several prestigious new contracts in pipe-end measurement, fit-up, weld/pipe
inspection and weld remediation.

[ All projects ][59]

# OMS and the energy transition

> “Technological advances made by innovators in the energy sector will speed up the world’s
> transition to sustainable power. Companies like OMS, with expertise in finding effective solutions
> to challenging situations, are ideally placed to support clients in a sustainable future.”

— Alex Felce, CEO

Clean energy is an exciting developing market for OMS. We offer a range of solutions to help clients
in [offshore wind][60] and [nuclear energy][61] overcome various challenges. We hold several patents
in the clean energy field and our in-house R&D and engineering teams are continually evolving our
capabilities in line with the challenges our customers are facing.

# Optics Cluster

The Optics Cluster (former Optics Research Group) of Delft University of Technology carries out 
research to achieve disruptive improvements in resolution and sensitivity for a plethora of
applications, and provides high level education and supervision of students and trainings for
industry. The Group is active in outreach, is co-leader of the Dutch Optics Centre and is/hs been in
the Boards of international and national optical societies such as ICO, EOS and PhotonicsNL.

**The Optics Cluster performs research in:**
* high resolution imaging and sensing,
* highly sensitive optical metrology,
* illumination and imaging instrumentation,
* new optical sources and detectors, in a wide wavelength range from x-rays to THz and with high
  application potential.

Scientific and technical breakthroughs are achieved by using and developing:
* opto-electronic devices to actively and adaptively shape and steer electromagnetic fields,
* new optical materials and resonant structures (e.g. hyperbolic media, graded index materials),
* computational optics and artificial intelligence to extract optimum information from measured
  data.

The Optics Cluster is part of the [Optics Netherlands][2] an initiative of Dutch academia, knowledge
institutes and industry aimed at boosting the Dutch economy in the field of optical technologies to
increase utilisation of Dutch science through joint R&D

# Optics Cluster

The Optics Cluster (former Optics Research Group) of Delft University of Technology carries out 
research to achieve disruptive improvements in resolution and sensitivity for a plethora of
applications, and provides high level education and supervision of students and trainings for
industry. The Group is active in outreach, is co-leader of the Dutch Optics Centre and is/hs been in
the Boards of international and national optical societies such as ICO, EOS and PhotonicsNL.

**The Optics Cluster performs research in:**
* high resolution imaging and sensing,
* highly sensitive optical metrology,
* illumination and imaging instrumentation,
* new optical sources and detectors, in a wide wavelength range from x-rays to THz and with high
  application potential.

Scientific and technical breakthroughs are achieved by using and developing:
* opto-electronic devices to actively and adaptively shape and steer electromagnetic fields,
* new optical materials and resonant structures (e.g. hyperbolic media, graded index materials),
* computational optics and artificial intelligence to extract optimum information from measured
  data.

The Optics Cluster is part of the [Optics Netherlands][2] an initiative of Dutch academia, knowledge
institutes and industry aimed at boosting the Dutch economy in the field of optical technologies to
increase utilisation of Dutch science through joint R&D

### NPI Video ADO: High Performance DC Fuse

The new SCHURTER ADO series is a fuse with a rated current range of 10 to 63 A and a maximum
operating current of 40 A at 1000 VDC. It is designed for applications in direct current systems up
to 1000 VDC and is suitable for use in electric vehicles.
[Play video]
[Supercaps]

### Energy Harvesting with SCHURTER Supercaps

The demand for fast and reliable energy storage is increasing in our connected, all-electric world.
SCHURTER’s prismatic supercapacitors are the world’s thinnest supercaps, offering the perfect
solution for rapid energy storage and release.
[Play video]
[Supercap SCPA]

### NEW: Prismatic Supercaps

Supercaps are a special type of energy storage device that combine the best properties of
rechargeable batteries and capacitors. They can store enormous amounts of energy and release it very
quickly. Watch our product introduction video to learn more.
[Play video]

### 7 Tips for Developing 'The Perfect HMI'

In this video, we share recommendations to help you make the right decisions when developing a PCAP
touch panel. And this only in 7 steps!

## SCHURTER – Your Reliable Partner for Future-Proof Filter Solutions

Discover SCHURTER’s comprehensive range of power entry and line filters designed for demanding
industrial, medical and energy applications. From compact DIN-rail solutions and high-performance
3-phase filters to robust DC filters for PV and storage systems – our products ensure excellent
attenuation, safety and compliance with global standards. Whether for compact devices or
high-current systems, SCHURTER filters offer reliable EMI suppression, high quality and easy
integration.

**
Explore the range and find the ideal filter for your application. **

[Discover our Top-Running Filters][114]

## EMC-Filter Cross-Reference

Play it safe: Find your SCHURTER alternative here.

[Find your SCHURTER Filter now][115]

## Green Line

SCHURTER presents the first 10A and 16A In-/Outlets made of plant-based plastic worldwide! The new
Green Line family includes the types 6100-3, 6100-4, 6102-3, 6102-5, 6600-3, 6600-4, 4782, 4797,
4798 and 6080.

[Read more about Green Line][116]
[Green Line Products by SCHURTER made of Bioplastic]

## Our knowledge at your service

SCHURTER has extensive in-house expertise in engineering, manufacturing, supply chain management,
testing and qualification as well as in various services. This makes SCHURTER an independent,
reliable partner for our customers.

[Discover our Competences][117]

## Statement by the SCHURTER Group on Supply Chain Resilience

At SCHURTER, we operate as a globally active company with production facilities strategically
located across multiple regions. We continuously invest in these facilities to ensure they are
equipped with the latest technologies, enabling us to operate efficient, internationally connected
production sites.

Being a reliable partner to our customers is at the heart of everything we do. That is why we have
built robust and resilient supply chains—both in collaboration with our suppliers and within our
globally interconnected production network. These supply chains are regularly exposed to simulated
stress tests, allowing us to proactively identify and prevent potential vulnerabilities.

Even In the case of geopolitical shifts, we at SCHURTER are well-prepared to maintain our high level
of delivery reliability. Our customers can rely on us to remain a consistent and dependable
partner—even in uncertain times.

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,
both today and tomorrow.

### Sustainable development: preserving our essentials

At SUEZ, our sustainable development roadmap is our blueprint to address the environmental and
climate challenges, go over and beyond our activities’ direct contribution to the ecological
transition, and thus accelerate our action to preserve what is essential. This is the profound
meaning of what we do at SUEZ, in the water and waste management businesses in which we have been
working with passion and determination for over 160 years.

### SUEZ innovation that matters

For more than 160 years, we have been innovating in the service of progress. We innovate when it
comes to the essentials: water, raw materials, energy, the climate. We share this mobilisation with
our customers and partners. Building on our historical expertise, as well as the new talent that
joins us, we are determined to accelerate innovation to preserve essential water and waste services,
both today and tomorrow.
